full_name: Haruko Momma | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Haruko Momma is the Julius Silver Professor and Professor of English at New York University and a status-only professor of medieval studies at the University of Toronto. She will work on a book that explores the theory and practice of names and naming in early medieval Britain by considering various cases of toponyms and anthroponyms and comparing them with similar examples from postmedieval global settings.
